text: On December 5, 2017, a request was made through MM35.3, to rename Rajah Park, located at 117 Rajah Street to Elijah Park. Property naming and renaming are a matter for which Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. The Parks, Forestry and Recreation Division has reviewed the Council-approved City of Toronto Property Naming Policy and found that this naming proposal meets the policy criteria and process. The Parks, Forestry and Recreation Division is recommending that Rajah Park located at 117 Rajah Street be renamed to Elijah Park.
North York Community Council: 1. Approved the renaming of Rajah Park, located at 117 Rajah Street, to Elijah Park.
